logger.doc:name: Log JMS Payload Construction Start
logger.message: #[write({ event: "CONTACT_ONBOARDING_JMS_PAYLOAD_BUILD_STARTED", correlationId: (vars.correlationId default correlationId) as String, contactId: vars.contactId default vars.contactDetails.Id default "UNKNOWN", replayId: vars.replayId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", changeType: vars.changeType default "UNKNOWN" }, "application/json")]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable:
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { contact_sf_id: vars.contactDetails.Id default vars.contactId default null,
first_name: vars.contactDetails.FirstName default null,
last_name: vars.contactDetails.LastName default null,
email: lower(vars.contactDetails.Email default ""),
phone: vars.contactDetails.Phone default null,
account_id: vars.contactDetails.AccountId default vars.accountId default null,
job_title: vars.contactDetails.Title default null,
department: vars.contactDetails.Department default null,
reports_to_id: vars.contactDetails.ReportsToId default vars.reportsToId default null,
reports_to_name: vars.managerDetails.Name default "Unassigned",
account_name: vars.accountDetails.Name default "Unknown",
account_industry: vars.accountDetails.Industry default null,
account_type: vars.accountDetails.Type default null,
account_revenue: vars.accountDetails.AnnualRevenue default null,
account_contact_count: vars.accountContactCount default 0,
contact_priority: vars.contactPriority default "NORMAL",
modified_date: if (!isEmpty(vars.contactDetails.LastModifiedDate default null)) ( vars.contactDetails.LastModifiedDate as DateTime { format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSX" } ) as String { format: "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss" } else null }

logger.doc:name: Log JMS Payload Construction Result
logger.message: #[write({ event: "CONTACT_ONBOARDING_JMS_PAYLOAD_BUILT", correlationId: vars.correlationId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", contactId: vars.contactId default vars.jmsPayload.contact_sf_id default "UNKNOWN", replayId: vars.replayId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", changeType: vars.changeType default "UNKNOWN", accountId: vars.jmsPayload.account_id default "NOT_AVAILABLE", accountName: vars.jmsPayload.account_name default "Unknown", accountContactCount: vars.jmsPayload.account_contact_count default 0, contactPriority: vars.jmsPayload.contact_priority default "NORMAL", modifiedDate: vars.jmsPayload.modified_date default null }, "application/json")]

logger.doc:name: Log AMQP Publication Start
logger.message: #[write({ event: "CONTACT_ONBOARDING_AMQP_PUBLICATION_STARTED", correlationId: vars.correlationId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", contactId: vars.contactId default vars.jmsPayload.contact_sf_id default "UNKNOWN", replayId: vars.replayId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", changeType: vars.changeType default "UNKNOWN", exchange: p("rabbitmq.onboardingExchange"), routingKey: p("rabbitmq.onboardingRoutingKey") }, "application/json")]

until-successful.doc:name: Retry Publish Contact Onboarding AMQP Message

amqp:message.amqp:headers: #[output application/java --- { CorrelationId: (vars.correlationId default correlationId) as String, ContactSfId: ( vars.contactId default vars.jmsPayload.contact_sf_id default "UNKNOWN" ) as String, SourceSystem: "Salesforce", EventType: (vars.changeType default "UNKNOWN") as String, ReplayId: (vars.replayId default -1) as String }]

logger.doc:name: Log Successful Contact Onboarding AMQP Publication
logger.message: #[write({ event: "CONTACT_ONBOARDING_MESSAGE_PUBLISHED", transport: "AMQP", broker: "RabbitMQ", correlationId: vars.correlationId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", contactId: vars.contactId default vars.jmsPayload.contact_sf_id default "UNKNOWN", replayId: vars.replayId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", changeType: vars.changeType default "UNKNOWN", exchange: p("rabbitmq.onboardingExchange"), routingKey: p("rabbitmq.onboardingRoutingKey"), publisherConfirmed: true }, "application/json")]
